title_zh: 选择不泄露结局的悬疑电影介绍

scenario.label_zh: 选择不泄露结局的悬疑电影介绍
scenario.goal_zh: 限定介绍只使用预告片已经透露的内容并约定不说出最后的反转

context_zh: 两位朋友讨论一部虚构悬疑电影，其中一人已看过全片，另一人只看过预告。
author: author-phase12-c

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: The trailer shows people starting to vanish from a small town. Is the whole film that eerie?

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Pretty much. But the reason they're disappearing isn't what I expected.

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: Don't tell me the reason. I've only seen what the trailer gives away.

sentences.speaker: Theo
sentences.text: Then I won't mention the final twist. Shall I just send you the title?

sentences.speaker: Nina
sentences.text: Please do. That's enough to make me want to watch it.
